searchText: I updated the `devnet-0` spec with 1) a release of the engine api (`v1.0.0-beta.4`) and 2) permalinks to the frozen EIPs. We should be able to consider the EL specs frozen now: https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/pectra-devnet-0 ``` tests-v1.5.0-alpha.0/mainnet/electra$ ls epoch_processing finality fork_choice operations random rewards sanity ssz_static sync transition ``` no `fork` tests this time? not yet! expect many more tests to be arriving in the coming months
